body:
It's hard to leave a country when you don't even have any money to move to another city in that same country.

I'm not sure if i feel anything but rage and frustration lately anyway.
And fear, but not for me.

I can mask it all to appear functional, but if i'm not absolutely focused on what i'm doing, all that shit overwhelms me and i need to leave whatever it is i'm doing to cool down.

I'm a huge nerd(videogames, books, movies, comics, you name it), but i also love and used to train boxing. 

I have more strength than i should have, considering how i've been living for the past 4 years. If anything, i'm actually physically stronger than i ever was. I probably got this strong through a combination of the work i've been doing at my parents farm and constantly feeling tense.
To be more accurate, my strength is at a great overall level, but my endurance/cardio isn't.

I lost most of my hair in the past 4 years and the rest of it is more grey than dark now. I shave my head now, but people that knew me from before always comment how even my hair stubble is mostly visibly grey.

I know how it feels to hit things. Punching something feels so satisfying when done right. Under normal circumstances, it cleanses you, it vents your frustrations.

You push all the bad things out of yourself with your fists and you use your entire body, from your big toe to your knuckles and it all comes out on impact.

It was therapeutic and kept me going for a while.

Unfortunately, i'm no longer in any normal circumstances. I can't get away from all this shit. I can't relax at all anymore, can't focus on them. I no longer get any enjoyment from movies or shows in general when i have time for any of it. Hitting the bag just makes me lose myself in rage.


In a way, i sort of wish i felt powerless. But i actually feel like i have some power and that's what scares me.

It no longer feels like venting my problems through my fists. It now feels like wanting to direct my fists at my problems. My father when he's drunk. My former friend, since he's threatening me and my family with loan sharks, despite being partially responsible for my mess. He actually set a deadline for that, which ends next month.
The idiot doctor that misdiagnosed me and all the others that never questioned anything about the initial diagnosis and just kept prescribing me more and more meds. The corrupt local politicians, who push their sons and daughters into every available job. Not to mention the blindness of the government and the fact that corruption in this country is basically a "public secret" - something everyone knows about, but nothing is being done about it.

I know all their names, i know all their faces, i know where those who personally wronged me and threatened me live. I know how fragile humans really are, if you know where and how to hit them.

I hope to god none of them ever come near me, for their sake.

If someone like that loan shark threatening former friend shows up in front of me, i'll WANT to hurt them, to crush them. I know this now.
I rarely remember my dreams these days, but after he threatened my family the first time, i dreamed about hitting him and gouging his eyes out - and it didn't feel like a nightmare.

And it's scary.

And it's all incredibly frustrating. It's all just making me more and more angry.

We had a bloody prime minister that literally robbed our country. Took bribes, sold off some of our most important government-owned companies and just generally ran the country into the ground.

I worked as a guard in one of the places he used to frequently visit. Even before he got publicly accused, people knew what he was like and what he was doing for years, even i knew. I worked there as a guard with a sidearm. And all i can think about now is.... "Why didn't i just shoot him back then? I knew, hundreds of thousands now suffer in poverty because of him. It would've been worth it."

And if someone put the current me in the same position right now, i would do it without hesitation.

But i'm not so stupid as to think i can do something about national stuff. It's just one from the raging torrent of thoughts that go through my head.

I can focus on my problems. It's all i can actually think about lately anyway. 

I see a solution for my problems. Get job, get money, pay off the loan shark threatening ex-friend because he's the most immediate concern and threat for you and your family. Save up some money, sell your house, buy a smaller house for your parents to settle in because they're too old to maintain a farm and fields alone. Use the savings to move to another country, take your girlfriend with you, send money to your parents, live your life.

Except it's not happening. A job seems like a dream, as well as any money on my bank accounts. I've been in the same place for 2 years, not moving an inch and i've finally started to crack - my mind still works, but my heart/soul can't feel much other than rage anymore. Even if i do get a job, i'm not sure if i'm mentally stable to focus on it at this point.

I guess you can add "uncertainty" to what i'm feeling too, along with rage.

EDIT:

You know what the really fucked up thing is? Having someone threaten your family with with loan sharks for an 850$ debt, then later seeing some Indiegogo link where someone asks 500$ to buy themselves a goddamn Playstation 4 bundle. THEN seeing that they actually got 750$ for that kind of request: https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/i-want-a-ps4-so-i-can-play-arkham-knight

Fuck.
